links.outcome: Whether RAG output incorporated evidence-based surgical guideline knowledge for patient-specific data
links.effect: Abstract reports SurgeryLLM demonstrably incorporated domain-specific knowledge from current evidence-based surgical guidelines; no numeric results are given in the text.
links.quote: SurgeryLLM, a large language model framework using Retrieval Augmented Generation demonstrably incorporated domain-specific knowledge from current evidence-based surgical guidelines when presented with patient-specific data.

screen.reason: Evaluates SurgeryLLM using retrieval augmented generation to incorporate evidence-based surgical guidelines for surgical decision support, but does not test a deployment practice comparative safeguard.
